HEADING: SSO Users
TEXT_INTRO: SSO users are the commenters your site signs in through Single Sign-On. Your SSO integration and the API create them automatically; you can also add, edit, and remove them here.
ERROR_DELETE_IN_PROGRESS: That SSO user is already being deleted. Refresh in a moment to see the result.
ERROR_DELETE_SERVER_RESTARTING: The server is restarting, so the SSO user was not deleted. Please try again in a moment.
LABEL_SEARCH: Search by ID, username, display name, or email
PLACEHOLDER_SEARCH: Start of an ID, username, name, or email
EMPTY_STATE: You don't have any SSO users yet.
EMPTY_STATE_SEARCH: No SSO users match your search.
